note: v490: More Statements hardening. Walking away from a running "Check all 12 months" no longer ends in a "couldn't reach the bank" error for a check that actually finished — the month marks were always saved, only the summary had nowhere to draw. Leaving the page mid-pull still records the month's result instead of losing it. Switching banks while a background check is running can no longer show the previous bank's pending count. Disconnecting a bank now scopes its cleanup to your own account at the database level too.
